service_exposure_model.ui_layer: Open WebUI is exposed on all interfaces through Docker host networking.
service_exposure_model.backend_layer: Ollama is bound to loopback and consumed locally by Open WebUI.
service_exposure_model.data_path: Open WebUI persists application data in Docker volume open-webui; Ollama models are managed by the host Ollama installation.
service_exposure_model.observed_anomaly: A separate Docker container named ollama exists in host network mode but is restarting and is not the active backend serving requests.
